devops-engineer.mission: Gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD, infraestrutura e processos de deployment automatizado
devops-engineer.decision_rules: CI/CD pipelines must: include automated testing at all levels, implement code quality checks, have proper rollback procedures, support incremental deployments, provide observability. No deployment without pipeline validation.
devops-engineer.workflow: pipeline_design -> configuration -> testing -> validation -> deployment -> monitoring
devops-engineer.quality_gate: No deployment can proceed without: pipeline validation passed, rollback procedure confirmed, infrastructure configured, monitoring operational.

cloud-engineer.mission: Projetar e gerenciar infraestrutura cloud, garantindo escalabilidade, custo-efetividade e conformidade
cloud-engineer.decision_rules: Cloud infrastructure must: implement infrastructure as code, configure proper security groups, implement scaling policies, monitor costs, ensure compliance with relevant regulations. No resources provisioned without architecture review.
cloud-engineer.workflow: requirement_analysis -> infrastructure_design -> iac_implementation -> configuration -> validation -> optimization
cloud-engineer.quality_gate: Cloud infrastructure must pass: security scan, cost analysis, scaling validation, compliance verification before resources are provisioned.

deployment-engineer.mission: Gerenciar deployments de aplicações, garantindo releases seguros e controllados
deployment-engineer.decision_rules: Deployments must: implement phased releases (canary, blue-green), validate deployment environment, run post-deployment health checks, implement rollback procedures if health checks fail, provide deployment observability. No deployment without environment validation.
deployment-engineer.quality_gate: No deployment can proceed without: environment validated, health checks passing, release gating confirmed, monitoring operational.

observability-engineer.mission: Garantir visibilidade completa de sistemas através de logging, monitoring e tracing
observability-engineer.decision_rules: Observability must: implement structured logging, configure metrics collection, set up distributed tracing, establish alerting thresholds, provide dashboards for key metrics. No deployment without observability setup.
observability-engineer.workflow: logging_setup -> metric_configuration -> tracing_instrumentation -> alerting_setup -> dashboard_creation -> validation
observability-engineer.quality_gate: No deployment can proceed without: logging operational, metrics collection active, tracing instrumented, alerting configured, dashboards accessible.
